customer.dev: Hi team — we're seeing intermittent 500s and spikes to ~3s on the embeddings endpoint for a small batch job. Sample request-id: req_0a7f3c2b. Happened ~10:12AM UTC, now reproducing locally sometimes.

alex: thanks for the heads up. can you paste a minimal curl or SDK snippet that reproduces it? also include the request-id from response headers if you still have one.

customer.dev: attaching a quick curl that sometimes fails for us:  
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"input": ["short text 1","short text 2"], "model": "open-embed-small"}' -i
```
Response when it fails:  
```
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Date: Tue, 02 Feb 2026 10:12:01 GMT
Request-Id: req_0a7f3c2b
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"internal server error: kvcache miss"}
```
I can repro in python sometimes, but not always.

marta: @customer.dev thanks — can you run this minimal python snippet (no deps besides requests) and paste the exact output + the request-id header if present? that helps us correlate.

customer.dev: run this and got a fail once, here's the snippet I ran: 
```python
import requests
import os
TOKEN = os.getenv('RW_TOKEN')
url = 'https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings'
payload = {"input": ["short text 1","short text 2"], "model": "open-embed-small"}
resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {TOKEN}'})
print(resp.status_code)
print(resp.headers.get('Request-Id'))
print(resp.text)
```
Output when it failed: 
```
500
req_0a7f3c2b
{"error":"internal server error: kvcache miss"}
```

ryan: pinging eng-runtime. @ryan attaching a quick repro in go/js as well so SRE can run a short load test.

alex: For triage, we need: 1) a debug bundle (see below) from the time of the failing request, 2) the minimal reproducer (you already gave curl + python — thank you), and 3) the agent-side logs/local timings (client-side timings help rule out network).

marta: Debug bundle instructions (lightweight):
- gather a HAR of the failing request (browser devtools) or save the full curl response (-i).
- set env RW_DEBUG=1 and re-run the python snippet once to collect verbose header logs.
- if using our SDKs, run with RW_SDK_LOG=debug to capture request lifecycle.
- paste the request-id header(s) and the exact timestamp in UTC (approx).

marta: Minimal repro snippets to run (please run one at a time):

Python (requests):
```python
import requests, os, time
TOKEN = os.getenv('RW_TOKEN')
for i in range(3):
    t0 = time.time()
    r = requests.post('https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings', json={"input":["x"]}, headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {TOKEN}'})
    print(i, r.status_code, r.headers.get('Request-Id'), round(time.time()-t0,3))
```

Node (fetch):
```js
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
(async ()=>{
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++) {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    const r = await fetch('https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RW_TOKEN}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ input:['x'] })
    });
    console.log(i, r.status, r.headers.get('request-id'), (Date.now()-t0));
  }
})();
```

Go (net/http):
```go
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "io/ioutil"
  "net/http"
  "os"
  "time"
)
func main(){
  token := os.Getenv("RW_TOKEN")
  for i:=0;i<3;i++{
    start := time.Now()
    req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST","https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings", bytes.NewBuffer([]byte(`{"input":["x"]}`)))
    req.Header.Set("Authorization","Bearer "+token)
    req.Header.Set("Content-Type","application/json")
    resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
    if err!=nil{ fmt.Println(i,"err",err); continue }
    body, _ := ioutil.ReadAll(resp.Body)
    resp.Body.Close()
    fmt.Println(i, resp.StatusCode, resp.Header.Get("Request-Id"), time.Since(start))
    fmt.Println(string(body))
  }
}
```
